game.title.description: Name of the Sudoku puzzle game.
game.title.notes: Sudoku is a loan-word in most locales — prefer the commonly-used form.

game.description.description: One-line description on the Sudoku game card.
game.description.notes: Short pitch: 9x9 number puzzle with easy/medium/hard difficulty.

game.playLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Sudoku play button.

cell.label.description: Screen-reader label for a grid cell, e.g. 'Cell row 3, column 5, empty' or 'Cell row 3, column 5, 7'.
cell.label.notes: `{{value}}` is either a digit 1-9 or the translated 'empty' string from cell.empty.

cell.empty.description: Text substituted into cell.label when a cell has no placed value.

cell.given.description: Added to a cell's screen-reader label when it holds a puzzle clue (a given) the player cannot change.

cell.entered.description: Added to a cell's screen-reader label when it holds a digit the player entered.

cell.box.description: Added to a cell's screen-reader label: which 3×3 (or 2×3) box it is in, numbered left to right, top to bottom.

cell.notes.description: Added to an empty cell's screen-reader label: the pencil notes it holds.
cell.notes.notes: `{{notes}}` is the digits, separated by spaces.

cell.conflict.description: Added to a cell's screen-reader label when its digit repeats one in its row, column or box (an illegal move).

cell.mistake.description: Added to a cell's screen-reader label when Show mistakes is on and its digit is not the solution (it breaks no rule).
cell.mistake.notes: Different from the conflict: no rule is broken, the digit is just not the answer.

cell.clash.description: Added to a cell's screen-reader label when it holds the digit that a conflicting cell in its row, column or box repeats.

numberPad.digit.description: Accessibility label for a digit key: the digit, then how many of it are still to place.
numberPad.digit.notes: `{{remaining}}` is a plain number: 0 means every instance is placed and the key is disabled. Keep "Enter digit" first.

numberPad.toggleNotes.description: Accessibility label for the pencil-marks toggle button.
numberPad.toggleNotes.notes: Applied to both the header toggle and the NumberPad button.

numberPad.notes.description: Short visible label for the pencil-marks toggle button ('Notes').

numberPad.erase.description: Accessibility label for the erase-cell button.

numberPad.eraseShort.description: Short visible label for the erase-cell button ('Erase').

difficulty.groupLabel.description: Accessibility group label for the difficulty radio buttons.

difficulty.easy.description: Label for the 'Easy' difficulty tier (36-44 given cells).

difficulty.medium.description: Label for the 'Medium' difficulty tier (28-35 given cells).

difficulty.hard.description: Label for the 'Hard' difficulty tier (22-27 given cells).

action.undo.description: Label + accessibility label for the Undo button.
action.undo.notes: Shares one line with four other actions on a 320 pt phone: keep it to a short word.

action.hint.description: Label for the Hint button — reveals the correct digit for the selected empty cell.
action.hint.notes: Shares one line with four other actions on a 320 pt phone: Russian Подсказка needs 9.

action.changeDifficulty.description: Label for the 'Change Difficulty' button (returns to the difficulty picker).

action.start.description: Primary CTA to start the chosen puzzle.

action.quickRestart.description: Secondary button in the New Game modal that immediately restarts with the same difficulty and variant, bypassing the selectors.

action.newGame.description: Label of the New Game button in the action bar under the board (opens a confirm, then the New Game picker).
action.newGame.notes: Shares one line with four other actions on a 320 pt phone: use the shortest natural form, one or two short words.

action.cancel.description: Closes the New Game picker without starting a puzzle.

newGame.title.description: Headline for the New Game settings modal shown after the player confirms abandoning their current game.

variant.groupLabel.description: Accessibility group label for the variant radio buttons.

variant.classic.notes: Show grid size after the name, e.g. 'Classic 9×9'. Sudoku is a loan-word.

variant.mini.notes: Show grid size after the name, e.g. 'Mini 6×6'.

preGame.title.description: Headline inviting the player to pick a difficulty.

hud.errors_one.description: Error counter for exactly one error (singular).
hud.errors_one.notes: Plural forms follow the i18next count rules for the language (add every category the language has, e.g. few/many for Russian, zero/two/few/many for Arabic). The limit counts the raw {{count}}.

hud.errors_other.description: Error counter for any other count of errors (plural).
hud.errors_other.notes: Plural forms follow the i18next count rules for the language (add every category the language has, e.g. few/many for Russian, zero/two/few/many for Arabic). The limit counts the raw {{count}}.

hud.elapsed.description: Accessibility label for the elapsed-time display.
hud.elapsed.notes: `{{time}}` is a formatted duration like 02:13 or 1:04:27.

a11y.board.description: Screen-reader label for the Sudoku grid.

settings.showMistakes.description: Label of the switch that colours digits which break no rule but do not match the solution.
settings.showMistakes.notes: Sits left of a toggle switch.

fullWrong.message.description: Shown when every cell is filled but the grid is not the solution; the banner has a Hint button beside it.
fullWrong.message.notes: Refers to the Hint button (action.hint) next to the message; keep the wording of the button name consistent with action.hint.
